overloads.semanticRole: Returns a two-dimensional collection (rows of subcollections of cell formula text) of the formulas within rangeObj.

constraints: If rangeObj designates multiple ranges, only the formulas of the first range are returned.
If rangeObj contains no formulas, an empty string is returned instead of a collection (per docs) despite the declared Collection return type.
The returned collection is two-dimensional: one subcollection per row, each subcollection holding the row's per-cell formula text.
